study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
exposure: Number of prior cesarean deliveries (1 vs. 2)
cohort: 10,262 women with 1 or 2 prior cesarean deliveries
finding: Labor induction outcomes were similar for women with 1 or 2 prior cesarean deliveries, and after 2 prior cesarean deliveries, undergoing induction carried similar maternal and neonatal risks as having a repeat cesarean section.
mod_finding: Among women with 2 prior cesarean deliveries, the rate of VBAC was not significantly different between those who underwent induction and those who had a repeat cesarean section.
